T4.9.message: Two small problems with how the notes match their sources. (1) The final sentence says the hymn 'repeats the Veda almost word for word', which goes further than the evidence. In shvetashvatara-upanishad.md, 3.2 and 6.11 share only eka ('one') with the verse. Where the verse says jagad-vyāpaka, the Upaniṣad says sarva-vyāpī, a different word. The idea is the same, but the wording is not. (2) The 3.2 quote 'एको हि रुद्रो न द्वितीयाय तस्थुर्य' stops in the middle of a sandhi join. The 'य' at the end belongs to the next word, य इमाँल्लोकान्. It matches the excerpt letter for letter, but it reads like a corrupted quote.
T4.9.suggested_fix: Change the last sentence to something like 'here echoes the Veda closely' or 'repeats the Veda's own idea of the One who pervades all'. Shorten the 3.2 quote to 'एको हि रुद्रो न द्वितीयाय तस्थुः' (or 'एको हि रुद्रो न द्वितीयाय'), or extend it to 'एको हि रुद्रो न द्वितीयाय तस्थुर्य इमाँल्लोकानीशत ईशनीभिः'.
